title: Three women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember three women, from Piedmont, Lombardy and Apulia. We keep them in our thoughts with gratitude and respect.

women.name: A little girl from Tortona
tribute: She was three years old and is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Vergiate
tribute: She was 36 years old and lived in Vergiate, in the province of Varese. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: Belgjyzar Shabani
tribute: Belgjyzar Shabani was 81 years old and lived in Lizzano, in the province of Taranto. She is in our thoughts.
